purpose: Gap G1 — ground the Transaction Coherence Score (TCS) against real funnel data

funnel_rates.note: orphan_transaction = purchase in a session with no add-to-cart (incoherent buy)

tcs_grounding.coherence_definition: satisfied causal edges / required causal edges per session, in [0,1]
tcs_grounding.organic_population: sessions with a funnel-backed transaction (view->cart->txn ordered)
tcs_grounding.orphan_population: transaction w/o cart, or cart w/o preceding view (attack analog)
